question: Which source-supported chemical and protein constraints place TDPn3 around the G7-M8 amide of ALQSSWGMMGML, and which observations test activity without proving the detailed mechanism or causal specificity?

alternatives_and_limits: The source notes that nucleophilic attack, hydrogen-bond rearrangement, or product release can be rate limiting in related metalloproteases; the detailed TDPn3 energy landscape was not measured or calculated.

The source does not directly observe proton transfers, the tetrahedral intermediate, or the reaction coordinate in TDPn3.

registration_counterevidence: Supplementary Table S2 annotates the TDPn3 reporter as ALQ/SSWG/MMGML, but lists only one measured C-fragment mass. That mass supports the intended cut-7 product after the source-wide approximately 21-22 Da offset; the table supplies no second fragment mass that independently establishes cut 3. The annotation still prevents an exclusive-fidelity claim.

Source-described TDPr3 substrate crystal 11DU lacks resolved Zn and places the S4-S5 bond at the active site, differing from intended S5-W6. This is a different construct/state/bond; no TDPn3 productive geometry can be filled from it. Mutation naming in source and deposit is handled separately by the lead.

measured_perturbation_and_outcome_eviden.perturbations: Each of two Zn-ligating histidines was changed to Ala, the Zn-ligating glutamate to Gln, the separate general-base glutamate to Gln, and the proposed oxyanion Tyr to Phe.
measured_perturbation_and_outcome_eviden.result: For all five main-text designs, mutation of any Zn-binding residue or the general base reduced activity at least sevenfold. Tyr-to-Phe reduced activity at least eightfold in four of the five.
measured_perturbation_and_outcome_eviden.assay_state: Separate protease and mScarlet-sfGFP substrate chains; source normalized proteases to 20 micromolar and substrates to 5 micromolar before mixing 5 microliters of each with 1 microliter of 500 micromolar ZnSO4 stock; 37 degrees C; 1 h and 8 h endpoints; triplicate SDS-PAGE densitometry with matched minus-Zn groups.
measured_perturbation_and_outcome_eviden.source_locator: Main text Fig. 3b and catalytic-residue paragraph; Supplementary Methods 3.6; Supplementary Figs. S6-S7
measured_perturbation_and_outcome_eviden.supports: The three-protein-ligand Zn center and separate general-base role are experimentally consequential across the main five source designs; a Tyr donor often contributes strongly.
measured_perturbation_and_outcome_eviden.does_not_support: the magnitude or necessity of any role in TDPn3, the identity of the fifth Tyr response from text alone, or universal necessity of Tyr in every designed catalyst

evidence_separation.proposed_chemistry: The Zn-water/general-acid-base mechanism and an oxyanion-stabilizing donor are source mechanism hypotheses. The source initially instantiated five amino-acid groups, but its Zn44 result makes Tyr identity conditional on useful geometry rather than universally hard.
evidence_separation.designed_geometry: The author model and AF3/TSA filters encode a selected geometry and candidate-selection criteria.
evidence_separation.recognition_model: Backbone pairing and individual contacts are computational recognition hypotheses.
evidence_separation.measured_function: Kinetics, mass-spectrometric cut assignments, and knockout/control outcomes show selected-construct function under stated assay contexts.
evidence_separation.causal_gap: No TDPn3 contact-by-contact mutagenesis or experimental productive-state structure links an individual recognition contact to specificity or an exact catalytic geometry to rate.
evidence_separation.coordinates: All selected/rejected ES, TSA and monomer coordinates are author predictions; native 4QHP and 1QJI are experimental inhibitor complexes; kinetics/products are experimental outcomes from the source. No equality of these evidence levels is implied.

transferable_constraints: two-His/one-Glu Zn ligation with a fourth, water ligand
a separate general-base/general-acid glutamate positioned for proton transfer
an oxyanion-stabilization strategy; Tyr OH is one source implementation with geometry that must be assessed alongside perturbation evidence, not assumed productive from identity or proximity alone
an attack trajectory that brings activated water to the scissile carbonyl carbon while Zn engages the carbonyl oxygen
an enzyme guide strand that constrains substrate backbone register around P1-P2'
explicit evaluation of apo, Zn-water enzyme-substrate, and transition-state-analog states
target_specific_interactions: pockets and contacts for W6, G7, M8, M9 and flanking residues in the selected TDPn3 model
the exact enzyme residue identities and rotamers realizing those contacts
not_transferable_without_new_evidence: the observed cut distribution from the TDP reporter to other substrate formats
the full-length TDP-43 outcome to endogenous intracellular TDP-43
the source's qualitative panel preference to proteome-wide specificity
a claim that any contact visible in the model causally creates specificity
a claim that passing AF3 geometry thresholds predicts activity or fidelity for new targets
Gly10 terminal OXT-specific contacts from the truncated 10-mer model to the internal Gly10 of the full 12-residue assay peptide
transferability.scope: The two-His/one-Glu Zn-water topology is specific to this hybrid design strategy; native astacin uses a chemically different third histidine ligand. These are candidate constraints to test when transferring this strategy, not universal requirements for peptide hydrolysis.

unresolved: The retained v3 text does not name the TDPn3 base-knockout residue or report its sequence.
No experimentally observed productive TDPn3 structure is reported.
The Fig. 5b TDPn3-versus-TDPr3 construct identity conflict prevents quantitative specificity extraction.
Supplementary Table S2 annotates reporter cleavage after local residue 3 but provides no second mass value independently supporting that annotation or its abundance.
The detailed TDPn3 rate-limiting step and energy landscape are unknown.
The source typo/inconsistency in the aminopeptidase-N theozyme residue list remains part of source provenance; deposited 4QHP coordinates resolve the actual adjacent residues as H293 and E294.
No retained TDPn3 mutation series establishes causal specificity contributions of the selected-model recognition contacts.
The 10-residue model omits assay positions 11-12 and supplies a different C terminus; the full 12-residue or full-length bound pose remains unmodeled here.
The saved monomer/ES/TSA predictions are not an equilibrium ensemble; favorable consistency cannot establish catalytic preorganization in solution.

raw_evidence_followup.question: What are the exact replicate-level fold effects for each catalytic-group substitution, which main-five Tyr response is below the eightfold threshold, and how variable is the Zn44 Tyr-to-Phe increase?
raw_evidence_followup.why_not_figure_only: The source text and Fig. 3b establish thresholded effects; the six CSVs supply replicate-level values, while the notebook is needed to preserve lane-to-variant mapping and the source's background/digested-fraction calculation. Figure S9 already supplies the angle/distance comparison.

decision.usable_relation: Exact 187-residue author-core identity now links chemical roles, selected ES/TSA/monomer atoms, a G7-M8 bond-registered contact map and source-measured turnover/products. Rejected sample0, native inhibitor templates and experimental assay states remain separate.
changed_inferences: Do not infer catalytic-base failure or a 54-degree attack geometry from the copied unfiltered ES sample0; selected ES sample3 gives a nearby base/water and 88.455-degree approach.
Do not carry the truncated-model Gly10 OXT-Thr132 contact into a 12-residue/full-length recognition constraint.
Do not make Tyr identity or a short Tyr-O distance universally sufficient: source Zn44 geometry/perturbation is a counterexample.
Do not infer apo Glu mispreorganization from OE1/OE2 label exchanges; symmetry-aware coordinate matching changes that conclusion.
decision.design_use: Preserve the source-specific metal/base topology and exact bond registration for any reproduction. Treat Tyr orientation, water placement and antiparallel register as hypotheses to retain and test together. Sidechain pockets are testable suggestions, not verified specificity determinants.
decision.direct_approach_baseline: A competent direct workflow using the same paper, notebook and coordinates can recover these constraints. This relation demonstrates a reusable join and prevents concrete state/atom-transfer errors; it does not establish better designed enzymes, comparative accuracy or measured time savings over that baseline.
decision.completion_boundary: The identity-and-coordinate mapping dependency is resolved. Further no-change geometry annotation is not the next task. A next design step requires a consequential role-dependent constraint difference and an authorized comparison or experimental plan; no new design/model execution is implied.

model_measurements.scope: All exact computed geometry and contacts are stored once here; role links select rows by state and metric ID.

role_contrasts.question: Does a modeled substrate hydrogen bond imply that its donor should be retained?
role_contrasts.interpretation: No universal retention rule follows from proximity. The source reports increased activity after removing or replacing an additional substrate-contact donor in Zn45/ZnO36 but decreased activity after replacing the designed oxyanion donor in Zn45_v2. Chemical role and construct background must accompany the contact.
role_contrasts.assay_boundary: Zn45 Y152 fixed-concentration screen and Zn45_v2 Y122 knockout are distinct variants, backgrounds and endpoints; do not calculate an opposing effect ratio or treat them as a matched kinetic comparison.
role_contrasts.mechanistic_boundary: Preferential ground-state stabilization, competition with an oxyanion hole and altered preorganization are proposed explanations, not measured per-mutant activation free energies.
role_contrasts.tdpn3_transfer_boundary: This contrast informs a role-dependent design policy only. No source-supported correspondence maps Zn45 Y152, Zn45_v2 Y122 or ZnO36 R79 onto a particular TDPn3 recognition residue.
